description: This file defines a React component for a UI document ingestion page, allowing users to upload files categorized as resumes, cover letters, or job descriptions. It includes UI elements, state management for previewing uploaded files, and dummy interactions for LinkedIn integration. The component manages local UI state and layout, but does not include backend API calls.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a number of bytes into a human-readable string with appropriate units (B, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension in uppercase or 'FILE' if none exists or filename is all uppercase.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID used for preview items.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns a title string for upload categories displayed in the UI.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Provides a color accent for each upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns a string specifying accepted file types for upload.

methods.name: UploadCard
methods.description: Component representing a file upload card with drag-and-drop and browse functionality.

methods.name: LinkedInConnect
methods.description: Component that simulates LinkedIn profile connection toggle.
